description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token, a Food token, a Clue token and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Baylen's first ability by tapping two tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite untapped tokens, you may tap them for infinite mana and forego sacrificing the Treasures, and/or use Baylen's other abilities.
